items.title: Abbey Lincoln — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Albert Popwell cursed the director out. I thought I wonder why he's doing that.

ctx.x: That time, yes. On the road. The director didn't direct it. Alvin Ailey finally directed it. I didn't know what a director did, and Albert Popwell cursed the director out. I thought I wonder why he's doing that. Anyway, it was like that, but Alvin helped. He came to help me. I mean, he was there and he directed the piece and I got good reviews. So, it's always been like that. You can't always count on what you think it's going to be, but you have to trust the life and sometimes it brings you things that you never…
